Name: Stun
Des: Cannot gain <Icon=IconOverClock|30|30|0.5/><color=#516797>Hypersequence</color> while being inflicted by Stun.

Name: Ignite
Des: When hit by enemy Skills, deal DMG equal to 10% Attack for every stack. Lasts indefinitely. Stacks infinitely.

Name: Knockback
Des: Enemies cannot trigger <Icon=IconBlock|30|30|0.5/><color=#516797>Block</color> while being inflicted with <Icon=IconHitFlyBlack|30|30|0.5/><color=#487F3B>Knockback</color>.

Name: Knockdown
Des: Enemies cannot trigger <Icon=IconBlock|30|30|0.5/><color=#516797>Block</color> while being inflicted with <Icon=IconHitDown|30|30|0.5/><color=#487F3B>Knockdown</color>.

Name: <CRIT>
Des: Consumes 1 stack of <color=#B96716><</color><Icon=IconCritBlack|30|30|0.5/><color=#B96716>CRIT></color> when using the next skill, and DMG dealt by that skill increases by 50%. Lasts indefinitely. Stacks infinitely.

Name: CRIT
Des: DMG dealt by this Skill increases by 50%.

Name: <Block>
Des: Consumes 1 stack of <color=#516797><</color><Icon=IconBlock|30|30|0.5/><color=#516797>Block</color> when hit by the next enemy skill, and DMG taken from that skill is reduced by 50%. Lasts indefinitely. Stacks infinitely. Cannot Block while inflicted with Knockback or Knockdown.

Name: Block
Des: DMG taken from this skill is reduced by 50%. Cannot Block while inflicted with Knockback or Knockdown.

Name: Rage
Des: Using skills grants <color=#9F3232><Icon=IconAnger|30|30|0.5/>Rage</color>. Lasts indefinitely.\nMax <color=#9F3232><Icon=IconAnger|30|30|0.5/>Rage</color>: 100. Triggers <color=#9F3232><Icon=IconAngry|30|30|0.5/>Berserk</color> at max Rage.

Name: Frenzied Assault
Des: <Icon=IconAngry|30|30|0.5/><color=#9F3232>狂暴</color>状态下，造成伤害提高20%，使用任意技能均将消耗10点<Icon=IconAnger|30|30|0.5/><color=#9F3232>怒火</color>，部分技能将触发额外效果。\n在<Icon=IconAnger|30|30|0.5/><color=#9F3232>怒火</color>消耗至0时，<Icon=IconAngry|30|30|0.5/><color=#9F3232>狂暴</color>状态结束。<Icon=IconAngry|30|30|0.5/><color=#9F3232>狂暴</color>无法叠加。

Name: Parry
Des: Triggers a <Icon=IconWrestle|30|30|0.5/><color=#B96716>Parry</color> at the start of battle and when both sides' <Icon=IconStamina|30|30|0.5/><color=#6F4877>Fighting Will</color> is depleted. The winner of the <Icon=IconWrestle|30|30|0.5/><color=#B96716>Parry</color> gains First Strike.

Name: Counter
Des: Triggers a <Icon=IconOverClock|30|30|0.5/><color=#516797>Counter</color> when either side's <Icon=IconOverClock|30|30|0.5/><color=#516797>Hypersequence</color> reaches 100 during a battle. The winner of the <Icon=IconOverClock|30|30|0.5/><color=#516797>Counter</color> gains First Strike.

Name: Initiative
Des: Certain skills can trigger additional effects when <Icon=IconWrestle|30|30|0.5/><color=#B96716>Initiative</color> is high.

Name: Hypersequence
Des: Certain skills can trigger additional effects when <Icon=IconOverClock|30|30|0.5/><color=#516797>Hypersequence</color> is high.

Name: Fighting Will
Des: Certain skills can trigger additional effects when <Icon=IconStamina|30|30|0.5/><color=#6F4877>Fighting Will</color> is high.

Name: Unique
Des: Identical effects only apply once and cannot stack.

Name: Shield
Des: When taking damage, consume <color=#516797><Icon=IconProtector|30|30|0.5/>Shield</color> to absorb an equal amount of damage. When both sides' <Icon=IconStamina|30|30|0.5/><color=#6F4877>Fighting Will</color> is depleted, clear the <color=#516797><Icon=IconProtector|30|30|0.5/>Shield</color> of both sides. When the Shield is hit by a <Icon=IconHitFlyBlack|30|30|0.5/><color=#487F3B>Knockback</color> or <Icon=IconHitDown|30|30|0.5/><color=#487F3B>Knockdown</color> skill, the damage taken is increased by 50%.

Name: The Light of Dawn
Des: 携带任意<color=#9B8015><Icon=IconSun|30|30|0.5/>曦光</color>效果的技能时，将激活特殊效果：每次使用主动/触发/拼刀/反制技能时，将分别积累10/15/20/20点<color=#9B8015><Icon=IconSun|30|30|0.5/>曦光值</color>。

Name: Dawnbreak Value
Des: <color=#9B8015><Icon=IconSun|30|30|0.5/>Dawnlight</color> caps at 120. Each time <color=#9B8015><Icon=IconSun|30|30|0.5/>Dawnlight</color> is full, depletes all <color=#9B8015><Icon=IconSun|30|30|0.5/>Dawnlight</color> and unleashes <color=#9B8015><Icon=IconSun|30|30|0.5/>Dawnbreak Radiance</color>: forcibly triggers the Trigger Skill in slot 1, ignoring its original activation conditions.

Name: Ignite
Des: When hit by enemy Skills, deal DMG equal to 10% Attack for every stack. Lasts indefinitely. Stacks infinitely.
